title: First Earth Battalion sergeant kills a goat with his mind, steals a helicopter and disappears

tellings.quote: uh, the guy who did did kill the goat experienced dying with the goat.

plain: A sergeant in the First Earth Battalion, an unusual US Army idea for training soldiers in mental and spiritual powers, is said to have killed a goat with his mind, then stolen a helicopter and disappeared. A former Army sergeant named Lyn Buchanan tells the story as it was passed on to him by an Army officer named Jim Channon, and adds that the man who killed the goat "experienced dying with the goat." If true, it would suggest that the mind can kill, and that doing so comes at a cost to the one who does it.
